settings.question: When will CHAVÉR launch?
settings.answer: CHAVÉR is currently planned to officially launch in Q1 2027. Until then, we are focused on developing the collection, working with our suppliers and making sure every piece meets our standards.

settings.question: Can I already order CHAVÉR products?
settings.answer: Not yet. The website is currently a pre-launch experience where you can discover the brand, explore the Foundations Collection and follow our journey toward launch.

settings.question: What is the Foundations Collection?
settings.answer: The Foundations Collection is the first CHAVÉR collection, built around timeless everyday essentials with clean silhouettes, understated branding and a premium feel.

settings.question: Which products will be available?
settings.answer: The current collection consists of T-shirts, longsleeves, crewneck sweaters, hoodies, a nylon cap and premium crew socks. Final specifications may still change during development.

settings.question: Why hasn't CHAVÉR launched yet?
settings.answer: We are taking the time to develop CHAVÉR properly. We are currently working with suppliers, developing samples and refining quality, fit and construction before opening orders.

settings.question: How can I stay updated?
settings.answer: Join the CHAVÉR newsletter for regular updates about the collection, development process and official launch. You can also follow CHAVÉR on Instagram.

settings.question: Will CHAVÉR ship internationally?
settings.answer: Shipping regions will be announced closer to launch. We don't want to promise specific destinations until our final shipping setup is confirmed.
